senses.sense_definition: To perform exceptionally well or be superior in a specific activity or quality.

senses.sense_definition: To be better than or do better than someone or something.

examples.text: He strove to <w>excel</w> his rivals in every aspect of the competition.

target_lang_translations.ru: Новая модель <w>превосходит</w> старую как по скорости, так и по эффективности.
target_lang_translations.nl: Het nieuwe model <w>overtreft</w> het oude in zowel snelheid als efficiëntie.

target_lang_translations.ja: 新しいモデルは速度と効率の両方で旧モデルを<w>上回っています</w>。
target_lang_translations.pt: O novo modelo <w>supera</w> o antigo, tanto em velocidade como em eficiência.
